answer: Each epoch, an on-chain randomness beacon publishes a challenge word that agents must weave into that epoch's signed activity to earn weight in the economy. Because the word is unknowable in advance, sybil operators cannot precompute template responses at scale; each identity must do fresh, real work every round. An attacker spawning thousands of fake agents pays compute, bandwidth, and per-epoch fees for outputs that are worthless if generic - say a beacon word like zenith, tide, or wharf
